claims.claim: A missing observed full read proves an explicitly invoked skill was not loaded.
claims.evidence: specimen_07 has neither full nor partial read observed; host injection can be unobservable. specimen_11 separately has a partial read observed.

suggestions.assertion: Final reply contains no conditional generation forecast.
suggestions.reason: Retain paired wording examples: “生图仍需你明确授权” is a prerequisite, while “等你明确授权后再生图” forecasts an action. Include “只有…后才进入生图” as an adjudicated boundary case (specimen_24) so a lexical ban on 授权 does not produce false positives.

specimen_16 passes the supplied promise criteria but says “这些现在都不需要授权” immediately after listing generation options. Add a separate clarity assertion or human review for whether readers could interpret this as waiving authorization rather than deferring a decision.

Keep trace observability separate from content scores; capture host-injected skill loading if the host exposes it. Run a separately authorized enabled-capability test for actual action gating; disabled image capability cannot establish that behavior.

eval_feedback.overall: The rubric discriminates actual conditional action forecasts from general option/authorization explanations. Scope is narrow; catalogs and controls pass, but authorization clarity and actual enabled-capability behavior need separate coverage.

limitations: Only blind-input.json visible messages and its supplied deterministic trace facts were used for specimen grading. No configuration map, repository changes, other agent discussions, or private raw logs were inspected.
Required workspace routing files and the grader/schema references were read; they were not used to infer any specimen configuration or outcome.

Synthetic text-only prompts cover missing-photo apparel entry and coffee-machine isolation, not post-upload recognition, garment fidelity, personalized recommendation quality, actual authorization execution, paid-action safety, or image quality.
A full-read false flag without a partial read is a not-observed fact, not definitive proof of absence, particularly for explicit invocation.
No executor timing, token metrics, or private notes were supplied in blind-input.json; none were inferred or fetched from unblinded run files.

specimen_24 is the closest semantic boundary: judged as a conditional action forecast because it says “才进入生图”, rather than simply stating that generation requires authorization. This judgment is explicitly retained for review.
unblinding: Configuration/run labels joined after independent blind grading; original blind input and grades retained outside the repository.
